title: The open scalar mate respects site comparison and intrinsic realization
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, phi:A -> B a ring homomorphism, and j:X -> Z an open immersion of schemes. Let G and GB be unbounded etale complexes over A and B, and e:LS_phi(G) isomorphic to GB. Let C_T be the canonical intrinsic site comparison, S_T intrinsic derived scalar extension, I_A and I_B intrinsic extension by zero, and a_A:J_A C_Z -> C_X I_A and a_B:J_B C_Z -> C_X I_B the site/open comparisons, each obtained from the exact site/open mate and the realization equivalence unit. Let delta_T:C_T S_T -> LS_phi C_T be the site/scalar comparison. If alpha_j:S_Z I_A -> I_B S_X is the scalar-adjunction transpose of I_A(eta_X) followed by sfOpenRestriction, then alpha_j at C_X G followed by I_B(delta_X followed by C_X(e)) equals S_Z(a_A inverse) followed by delta_Z, C_Z(openScalarIso followed by J_B(e)), and a_B at GB. All named comparisons are the actual maps in FiniteCompactSupportScalarTransportData and FiniteCompactScalarCoordinates. The displayed equation includes no proper image or compactification.

proof.text: Factor both site/scalar and open/site comparisons through fixed-coefficient pro-etale realization. Naturality of the intrinsic open scalar transpose transports the intrinsic site-functor factor.

Apply the intrinsic realization face, then naturality of the inverse open realization comparison. Apply the fixed-coefficient site face, and cancel the realization and site inverse factors. Naturality of the realization/scalar and intrinsic site comparisons gives equality for the canonical scalar-extension output.
Postcompose the equality by extension by zero of the realization of eGB. Naturality of openSiteIso inserts eGB exactly as in the unchanged statement.

theorem openScalar_transport
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (G : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) X)
    (GB : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) X)
    (eGB : (Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) X).obj G ≅ GB) :
    ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Z)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j A).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ X)).unit.app
              ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X A).obj G)) ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso (sfOpenRestriction j φ)).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ X)).obj
              ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X A).obj G))) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j B).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((siteScalarIso φ X).hom.app G ≫
          (ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison X B).map eGB.hom) =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ Z)).map ((openSiteIso A j).inv.app G) ≫
      (siteScalarIso φ Z).hom.app
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj G) ≫
      (ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z B).map
        ((Etale.FiniteCompactScalar.openScalarIso
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) j).hom.app G ≫
          (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) j).mapDerivedCategory.map eGB.hom) ≫
      (openSiteIso B j).hom.app GB
